The '''Ladarra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ladarra]].
